title: Bee Removal in Westbury, Long Island
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee and ground bee nest treatment and removal in Westbury, Long Island. Licensed experts. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: When wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, or ground-nesting bees establish nests in your Westbury home or business, you need fast professional treatment to protect your property and family. The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional nest identification, treatment, and removal throughout Westbury and surrounding Long Island communities. Our licensed technicians handle everything from aggressive yellow jacket colonies in wall voids to carpenter bee galleries in structural wood.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has served Westbury residents and businesses for years with reliable, eco-conscious bee removal solutions. Our team combines local knowledge of Long Island's unique bee activity patterns with advanced removal techniques, ensuring your property is bee-free while protecting these important pollinators whenever possible.
localContext: Westbury's mix of residential neighborhoods, commercial districts along Old Country Road, and proximity to Eisenhower Park creates diverse environments where wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets often nest in eaves, soffits, chimneys, and wall voids. The area's mature trees and gardens throughout the village attract carpenter bees to wooden trim and decking, while ground-nesting yellow jackets burrow into lawns and landscaping beds — making professional nest treatment essential for homeowners and business owners alike.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Westbury?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you treat a wasp or hornet nest in my Westbury property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service throughout Westbury and Long Island. Most nest treatments are completed within 2–4 hours, though nests deep inside wall voids or attics may require additional time. We prioritize emergency situations where aggressive stinging insects pose immediate safety risks.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Westbury?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Will wasps or yellow jackets return after nest treatment?
faqs.answer: Our comprehensive service includes nest treatment, removal of accessible nest material, and sealing every entry point to prevent recolonization. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
